reasons: The run loaded servo/wheel targets from legacy event command_state_after snapshots. Some late ordinary UI events contain the pre-command snapshot, so targets were delayed by one event.

The process was launched before exact-replay termination was disabled. A terminal predicate triggered DirectRLEnv auto-reset, so the reported final pose is the reset pose rather than the final replay pose.
The process was launched before collision classification switched from the legacy geometry proxy to actual ContactSensor non-wheel force.
preservation_policy: Artifacts are retained as a failed diagnostic and must not enter any formal baseline, success-rate, ablation, or statistical result.

corrected_by.runner: src/resume_validation/replay_direct_validation.py disables episode termination while recording all failure predicates
